page.layout: One page of text; a large decorative woodcut initial block in the text; marginal notes in the left margin (Gen. 1.1.2.3; Josephus Antiquit. lib. 1 c. 2.) above the text lines of the first column.

main_text.l: Caput I. De Rebus ante Noachum gestis.
locatus, imperium in terram (sic Politia constituta
est) & mandatum de non comedendo ar-
boris scientiæ boni & mali fructu (sic Ecclesia ste-
tit) accepit. Sed cùm Sathanæ astu, & blanditiis
muliebribus inductus, illud violasset, morti obnoxius
esse cœpit. Pereuntem DEUS ipse erexit, &
facto, de seminæ mulieris caput serpentis
contriturâ, promisso, quo Evangelio initia data funt.

page.notes: Left margin notes are partly illegible in the scan; the printed notes are reproduced as best read. Woodcut initial "R" with figures. Several words in the paragraph are uncertain due to the faint print and the damaged right edge; the text at the right margin of the last lines appears cut off. Some Greek-free text; no Greek or Hebrew printed.
